title: OPEN HEART — Garden Signal 002
dek: Four chrome garden doors, five original touch tones, and one official Spotify doorway
body:
OPEN HEART is an ode built beside Pete Townshend’s “Let My Love Open The Door — E. Cola Mix.” The record remains inside Spotify’s official player. PointCast adds a neighboring visual and sonic garden: four new Midjourney exposures, a chrome threshold, five browser-native touch tones, and a twelve-step pattern running at its own 92 BPM.

The interaction copies none of the recording. There are no downloaded tracks, samples, stems, transcribed melodies, lyrics, playback synchronization, or proxied Spotify assets. Door, Petal, Chrome, Breeze, and Open are synthesized in the browser from oscillators and generated noise after the visitor’s first gesture.

The visual system comes from one Midjourney job made in Michael Hoydich’s signed-in account: a mirrored door inside a saturated Southern California flower wall, photographed like a glossy late-1990s editorial spread. The four source frames, their hashes, the full prompt, audio tuning, pattern, provider boundary, and credits are published in the adjacent JSON.
